name: Markdown Exporter
headline: Markdown Exporter - Convert Markdown to Documents
short_description: Transforms Markdown into DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, PNG, PDF, Mermaid, HTML, MD, CSV, JSON, XML. Useful for operations teams to automate document generation from Markdown. Integrates with Dify and Claude agents.
author: bowenliang123

sections.overview:
Markdown Exporter is an agent skill and Dify plugin that converts Markdown text into 15+ professional document formats including DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, PDF, PNG, HTML, CSV, JSON, XML, and Mermaid diagrams. It processes all conversions locally for complete privacy, with no data leaving your environment. The tool supports customizable templates for DOCX and PPTX output, multi-language content, and works with Claude Code, agent frameworks, and CLI environments. Operations teams use it to automate document generation workflows, while developers integrate it into Claude agents and LangChain frameworks for programmatic format conversion.
Automate report generation from Markdown templates into DOCX for compliance documentation
Convert meeting notes to PPTX presentations with custom branding templates
Transform Markdown tables into XLSX spreadsheets for data analysis
Generate PDF invoices and forms from Markdown source documents
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/bowenliang123/md_exporter`
sections.usage:
```
Convert the following Markdown content into a [FORMAT: DOCX/PPTX/XLSX/PNG/PDF/HTML/CSV/JSON/XML]. Include all formatting, tables, and images. [ADDITIONAL_INSTRUCTIONS: e.g., 'Use the corporate template for the DOCX output' or 'Ensure the PNG has a white background']. Markdown content: [MARKDOWN_CONTENT]
```
Copy

```
Here is the converted DOCX document based on your Markdown content. The document includes all the headings, bullet points, and tables from the original Markdown. The corporate template has been applied, and the company logo is included in the header. The images have been properly embedded, and the formatting matches the original Markdown structure. The document is ready for distribution to the team.
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
